method.catalogueScreen: Metadata-level category and task-keyword screening across all entries; not a security audit of all 4400 projects.
method.limitation: No new candidate is certified SaaS-compatible by this source survey. Admission requires the scoped test matrix in the design.
method.selection: Category/task-keyword screening plus supplementary primary-repository discovery; source versions are resolved independently from catalogue versions.
